matches.rationale: No finding identifies Equation (4)'s specific recursive inconsistency of feeding the prior V values into a softmax update while treating V as normalized reliability weights. Findings 2 and 4 discuss different consequences of the channel-wise/TopK design rather than this update-rule defect.
No finding addresses the Section 3.3 multi-step-training claim or compares it with the reported growth of errors at longer forecast horizons.

pred_verdicts.rationale: It identifies a concrete cross-section inconsistency in the reported training and test date ranges, which is not among the listed ground-truth defects.
It plausibly identifies that the stated channel-wise, spatially pooled selection cannot provide region-specific adaptation, a distinct issue from the Equation (4) normalization update.
It identifies a concrete apparent lead-time unit error in Appendix D, unrelated to either ground-truth method-logic defect.
It plausibly identifies consequences of the deployed K=1 TopK selection, rather than the specific recursive softmax/V-update inconsistency in ground truth 1.
